messages:
maria: Anyone know the grafana shortlink for APAC model-health + kv-cache metrics? I'm chasing p95 spikes in ap-southeast tests and the usual dashboard 403s me. Need panel with: model latency, kv_cache_hit_rate, serving errors.
vikram: Try this one: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/model-health/apac?orgId=1&var-region=ap-southeast-1
vikram: If you get 403 it's in the ops-apac team org, you need viewer role or open via the workspace pin.
sam-ops: fwiw here's the model overview: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/service-overview/model-serving?orgId=1
sam-ops: Loki query for kv cache hit rate (per-minute):
sam-ops: ```loki
{app="model-serving",region="ap-southeast-1"} |= "kv_cache_hit" | unwrap value | avg_over_time(1m)
```
maria: clicking the first link => 403 Forbidden. Error: You don't have permission to view this dashboard (req id xyz-123). Tried incognito.
lisa: @maria sorry, I can see the deny. I'm giving you viewer role on ops-apac now.
rbac-bot: role change: maria -> viewer in team ops-apac (granted by lisa) ✅
grafana-bot: dashboard access audit: user=maria granted VIEW on dashboard=apac-model-health (id=876) at 2025-10-29T14:27:00Z
maria: ok can open now, thanks! panels look good. The kv_cache panel shows a dip ~14:12 that aligns with p95 spike.
ryan: on alerts: suggest we relax the model-serving p99 latency alert for non-production from 600ms -> 900ms and increase eval window 5m->10m. Otherwise it'll keep firing on warmup bursts.
sam-ops: +1. Also add a silenced tag for canary runs. I'll open a PR to change rule and add a note in runbook.
maria: thanks all. @sam-ops can you paste the alert rule link when PR is up? I'll attach screenshot to the incident.
sam-ops: will do. Also created quick pin: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/short/abc123 that exports the panels we used.
maria: saved. closing the loop — thanks! :thumbsup:
